extracted_concepts.name: Counting
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Counting by ones and tens to 100 or 120.

extracted_concepts.name: Cardinality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Understanding the relationship between numbers and quantities.

extracted_concepts.name: Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A symbol or word used to represent quantity.

extracted_concepts.name: Quantity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: How many objects or amounts are present.

extracted_concepts.name: Addition
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Putting together and adding to.

extracted_concepts.name: Subtraction
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Taking apart and taking from.

extracted_concepts.name: Place Value
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The value of a digit based on its position, such as ones, tens, or hundreds.

extracted_concepts.name: Ones
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Single-unit place value position.

extracted_concepts.name: Tens
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Place value position representing groups of ten.

extracted_concepts.name: Hundreds
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Place value position representing groups of one hundred.

extracted_concepts.name: Base Ten Numeration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Number system using bundles of hundreds, tens, and ones.

extracted_concepts.name: Skip Counting
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Counting by intervals such as 5s, 10s, or 100s.

extracted_concepts.name: Measurement
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Determining length, time, or other measurable attributes.

extracted_concepts.name: Length
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: How long an object is.

extracted_concepts.name: Length Units
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Units used to measure length.

extracted_concepts.name: Time
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A measurable amount telling when events occur.

extracted_concepts.name: Hours
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Units used to tell time.

extracted_concepts.name: Halves
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Two equal parts, used in telling time to the half hour.

extracted_concepts.name: Data
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Information that can be organized, represented, and interpreted.

extracted_concepts.name: Shapes
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Two-dimensional or three-dimensional figures.

extracted_concepts.name: Defining Attributes
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Attributes that determine what a shape is.

extracted_concepts.name: Two-dimensional Shapes
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Flat shapes with length and width.

extracted_concepts.name: Three-dimensional Shapes
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Solid shapes with length, width, and depth.

extracted_concepts.name: Equal Groups
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Groups of objects with the same number in each group.

extracted_concepts.name: Money
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Coins and bills used to solve value problems.

extracted_concepts.name: Coins
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Money such as quarters, dimes, nickels, and pennies.

extracted_concepts.name: Dollar Bills
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Paper money used in money problems.

extracted_concepts.name: Rectangles
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Shapes that can be partitioned into rows and columns of squares.

extracted_concepts.name: Rows and Columns
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Arrangements of same-size squares in rectangles.

extracted_concepts.name: Partitioning
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Dividing a shape into parts.
